content: Əlbǝga Yuhwan Dadda kwa ɓagar Tsuufǝg kǝ Uudaha
Kwanǝnna iin nǝ ǝlbǝg maraw tǝghǝr kǝ Yesu Kǝristi, Zǝra Daadamazhigǝla.
Bandkwa fǝgharzha nǝ tlayang Ishay kǝ vindǝgaan ma kakkaɗaan taakiya,

content.text: “Am Daadamazhigǝla, ‘Ənda ɓǝlgaan kǝ zǝr ɓǝlgar kiyava ɓadlak ɗuul lakuti aghada saaya.’
Uudana ɓǝla tlǝhǝg ma tǝghala taakiya, ‘Ɓadlamarnaɓadlǝg kǝ ɗuulaan kǝ Yaazhigǝl ba ndǝɗɗa.’ ”

content: Tsugwa ba nǝ Yuhwan dadda tsufǝg ma tǝghala, kaa tagtǝr ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl kǝ uudaha. Amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, pǝlampǝlǝg kǝ ghǝra ɓag kura nǝ uud kǝ tsuufǝga, dlaɓa ɓǝshkurna Daadamazhigǝl kǝ haipaharuwa.
Kaa ba sagau kǝ uudah baɗyak ma haiya Yahudiya, ard uudah ma kǝssa Wurshalim da vak Yuhwana. Ar tagaan kǝ haipahatǝra, ɓagtǝra kǝ iin kǝ tsuufǝg ma zaagha Judan.
Sǝɗavi tsuguv Yuhwan ɓagava dǝ guja adlǝgwama. Dǝga ndzǝɗa huɗaana ɓagava dǝ hǝluwa, dlaɓa dǝga zǝgaana, ndzaba ayayuwa ard yuwa mamma.
Kaa tagtǝrtag kǝ iin kǝ uudah taakiya, “Daddakwa da sagau tǝ halara jakwaraajig dǝ ndangǝra, kwa tlanalbi nai kǝ ngǝghrangǝg da pǝla aanji zawwa kimbakaan biya.
Kai ǝn ɓagkur dǝ yu kǝ tsuffǝga, iina da ɓagkur dǝ Shǝɗǝkwa Daadamazhigǝl kǝ tsuffǝga.”
Ɓagavaraɓag Tsuufǝg kǝ Yesu
Makwahiin kǝ sarta, sǝghaasǝg nǝ Yesu saama kǝssa Nazarat ma haaya Galili. Kaa ɓagaraɓag kǝ Yuhwan kǝ tsuffǝg ma zaagha Judan.
Bad sagal Yesu ma yuwa, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ ghǝrazhigǝl wurga, dlaɓa kaa tsugwatsugw Shiɗǝkwa Daadamazhigǝl saay da tǝghǝr kǝ iin band garava kakura.
Kaa cinngalcinng nǝ kungy sii ma ghǝrazhigǝl taakiya, “Kǝgh zǝrara, ǝn wayakwaig ba vaivaiya.”
Fǝshafǝshǝg Shatanah kǝ Yesu
Zǝlamai tǝhala kwah biya, kaa langaan kǝ Shǝɗǝkwa Daadamazhigǝl kǝ Yesu damma tǝghala,
hǝngaan kwul uufaɗ ba vaakwaha, fǝshgaan Shatanaha. Yesu ndzar ǝmtaɗ dǝ dǝg tǝghalaha, dlaɓa zarha ɓǝlga Daadamazhigǝla sarǝvsǝg da mǝlgarumǝlga.
Fǝgharzhafǝg Yesu kǝ ɓa tlǝraan ma Galili
Tǝhalakwa ɓǝlavdǝm Yuhwan ma guda bǝrfina, kaa dagal kǝ Yesu damma Galili taa ǝlbǝg maraw tǝghǝr kǝ Daadamazhigǝla.
Amaa, “Ɓagaaɓag sarta. Tlǝkǝsǝra Daadamazhigǝl hǝrzǝthǝrzǝg saaya. Pǝlampǝlǝg kǝ ghǝra, am fǝdghǝrǝt tǝ ǝlbǝg marawǝna.”
Ɗahatǝrǝɗahǝg Yesu kǝ Lii Vaiya Kilfah Uufaɗa
Ghuda dagal nǝ Yesu tǝvǝgh kǝ yuwahaiya Galili, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iin kǝ Siman ard zǝrababbaan Andrawus, ar bǝla amshiyaha vaiya kilf ma yuwahaiya aɗaba ar ya dadda vaiya kilf nǝ iitǝra.
Am Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Gatamkwagatǝga, ǝn da nǝkurdalnǝg kǝ lii ɗaha uudah sa vakara.”
Bat watswatsǝra, kaa ɗugarsɗuug kǝ iitǝr kǝ amshiyaha vaiya kilfatǝra, kaa gatǝgaan kǝ iitǝra.
Gavǝt ba nǝ iin da tǝvukw hǝɗikǝnana, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iin kǝ zarha Zabadi, Yakuba ard Yuhwana. Ar ma pɛrayuwa, ar ɓadla amshiyaha vaiya kilfaatǝra.
Bat watswatsǝra kaa ɗahtǝrǝt kǝ iina, kaa ɗugarsɗuug kǝ iitǝr kǝ daddaatǝr Zabadi ma pɛrayu ǝmtaɗ dǝ lii hutsarant nǝ iitǝr kǝ ɓa tlǝra, kaa gataa Yesu kǝ iitǝra.
Dadda kwad Shǝɗkw Ghwaɗa
Yesu ard lii gatǝgaan daragha damma kǝssa Kafarnahuma. Ɓagaa ba Faciya Ngiiga, kaa daas kǝ iin damma guda dzahava Yahudaha, kaa farzha tsagtǝr dǝgit kǝ uudaha.
Kaa ɓa jappǝr kǝ iitǝr dǝ tsagaanana, aɗaba tsagatǝr dǝgit ba kalkala, gǝrgǝr dǝ ɗuuli tsag nǝ lii tsaga adzahadzaha Musa.
Maay ma taaɗatǝr biya, kaa dǝgaadǝg kǝ uuda nǝ iin kwa dǝ shǝɗǝkw ghwaɗ damma guda dzahava, huulǝg taakiya,
“Au lambagh dǝ kǝmnd Yesu Uuda Nazaret? Agha sagau da ghyǝhha kǝmnda? Ən sǝrgasǝrga magha war nǝngnga. Kǝgh daddakwa Caccuwanacaccuwanan sahi vak Daadamazhigǝla.”
Kaa cagaraacag nǝ Yesu kǝ gyi kǝ shǝɗǝkw ghwaɗǝna, amaa taa kǝ iina, “Ɗǝw amǝnga. Assagal ma uudanǝna.”
Kaa gajagantgajag ba dladlaɗ nǝ shǝɗǝkw ghwaɗǝn kǝ uudanǝna. Kaa huulǝg kǝ iin dlaɓa kaa tsugwa dagalaana.

Baɗǝm nǝ uudahi ndzar vaakwahiin ar ɓa jappǝr ba vaivaiya, baz ndava ghǝrahaatǝr kǝ iitǝr taakiya, “Au wa nǝ iini? Kwar kǝ daala tsaga dǝgit wanii? Tsaga dǝgit ba kalkala. Baz fǝtǝraafǝg kǝ iin kǝ shǝɗǝkw ghwaɗah kǝ ɓa dǝgiti naag nǝ iina.”
Caaricaari nǝghar bak cinngalcinng nǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ iin aanji taakwar mahuɗa haaya Galili.
Mbǝghanambǝg Yesu kǝ Babba uusa Bitrus
Ba dǝ Sagala Yesu ǝmtaɗ Yakub ar dǝ Yuhwana ma guda dzahava, kaa daas kǝ iitǝr da vǝgyaz Bitrus ar dǝ Andrawus.
Babba uusa Bitrus hǝngan njǝkǝn fǝɗa. Bat watswatsǝra, kaa tagartag kǝ iitǝr kǝ Yesu kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝra.
Kaa dagau kǝ iin da vakaana, hakyǝnan kǝ dǝvaan ciyanta. Kaa ɗugarsɗuug fǝɗiina, tǝhalakwaha bagtǝra nǝ uusǝn kǝ dǝgzǝga.
Dǝghwaasa, tǝhala daaya faciya, kaa sǝdǝvsǝg kǝ uudah kǝ lii yangbi baɗǝm ard lii dǝ shǝɗkw ghwaɗ ma vǝghahaatra.
Kaa dzahav kǝ lii ma kǝsiin baɗǝm tǝghaiya hǝnyahiina,

kaa mbahnambahǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ lii dǝ kuzah shahshaha. Lagudan baz shǝɗǝkw ghwaɗ mavǝgh kǝ uudaha ba ɗyaka. Ɗuwatǝrnai kǝ shǝɗkw ghwaɗah kǝ taaghai biya, aɗaba ar sǝrgasǝrg ghǝravaatǝr taaki ma war nǝ iina.
Dal da taa ǝlbǝg Maraw Yesu
Dlakadur ba wurra, lakuti cag nǝ kǝsa, ciyitciig nǝ Yesu ɗugharsɗuug kǝ hǝnyaha, kaa dagal kǝ iin da vakavaki maay band war biya. Dzugwa kǝ iin kǝ zhigǝl vaakwaha.
Kaa dagal kǝ Siman ǝmtaɗ dǝ tsaghwaha dagalaan da gatǝgaana.
Tlararaa ba nǝ iitǝra, kaa tagaratag kǝ iitǝr taakiya, “Baɗǝm nǝ uudah ar gatakǝgha.”
Ngwangwug nǝ Yesu amaa, “Jiyam dagal damma gǝdzǝr kǝssahi kwa hɛffa, kiyava da taa ǝlbǝg maraw kǝskai vaakwah dlaɓa. Aɗaba sanhi mbakyarvad kwah naiya.”
Tǝhala kwaha kaa gwaivagwaig kǝ iin baɗǝm ma haaya Galili, taa ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝla ma guda dzahavaatǝra. Lagwdaan dlaɓ kǝ shǝɗkw ghwaɗah ma vǝgha uudaha.
Mbǝghanambǝg Yesu kǝ Dadda Vǝca
Mǝng nǝ uuda nǝ iin njǝkǝn vǝca sǝv sa vak Yesu, kǝla kǝ iin kǝ ghunja kaa ghalgaan taakiya, “Ma haighanthaiga, agha mbǝkwimbǝgga.”
Kaa zhugardaalazhug kǝ Yesu, ɓǝlaraa kǝ dǝva, amaa taa kǝ iina, “Haiyanant haiga, mbambǝgga.”
Bat watswatsǝra kaa ɗugarsɗuug kǝ kuza vǝciina, kaa mbǝgambǝg kǝ iina.
Kaa ɓǝlgaraɓǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ magiya ba vaivaiya, ɓǝlars kǝ iin dagala.

“Tagarbi aanji ndǝwar kǝ dǝgiti aa dzǝgardzǝg biya. Dǝga agha marda kǝ ghǝragh vak zhiil kǝsuufa, agha ɓaga kǝ kyulǝg bandkwa tagada Musa taakiya aa ɓagavɓag mbakyarvad caccuwagha. Ɓagnaɓag kwana kiyava fadghǝr kǝ uudah taakiya mbǝghambǝga.”

Dlakulva kwaha, kaa ba dagal kǝ ghwalvǝn kutǝgaana kǝ ɗuuli mbavǝna dǝ iina. Kwan wa fǝghǝra shǝɓav kǝ Yesu akwama dagal damma kwatlǝrǝn kǝ kǝssa, kaa ndza kǝ iin vakavaki maay ndǝwar biya. Bakǝvakwaha, ar fǝgarna ba sagau nǝ uuda da vakaan aanji takwara.
